description.en:
If you are aware of fashion in Japan you must have seen Liliko’s face. For the last few years she has been at the top of the modeling world, with her face and body promoting the biggest brands. But as everyone who is in this world admits, staying on top is a constant and never ending battle. There are always new faces introduced to the public. Younger models and new looks are brought into the fold every season. And keeping that position means learning to adapt and learning to cope with change.

To maintain her position, Liliko has decided to go under the knife. This is not her first go with this service. It is yet another round of plastic surgery, all done to keep herself looking young and vibrant. However, in this case just a little nip and tuck was not enough. Liliko is bent on undergoing a full body makeover. From head-to-toe, every inch of her will undergo cosmetic surgery, and thus begins her madness. [Kodansha]

biography.en:
After dropping out of Aichi Prefectural University of Fine Arts and Music, he made his professional debut when "Kotetsu no Queen" was published in Weekly Shonen Jump Extra in 1975. In the same year, he received the Tezuka Award as the best young comic creator for his [Harukanaru Asa](https://mangadex.org/title/153ea575-6369-4377-aa7a-88d31d199f3c/the-distant-dawn) and quickly established himself as the most promising mangaka in 'hard' science-fiction manga.

His specialty is SF, but he is also interested in history; his most recent stories are concerned with ancient history and folklore.

His major works include [2001 Ya Monogatari](https://mangadex.org/title/7882bc0d-f0b6-4cb5-8c30-d632ad214abd/2001-nights), [Yamataika](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=27638), and [Munakata Kyouju Denkikou](https://mangadex.org/title/bfa23abe-21d3-4f3a-b3a1-20ed8b4cd539/the-legendary-musings-of-professor-munakata).

[Uoto Osamu](https://mangadex.org/author/db3c2c46-9696-4e2b-8725-804fcec2c66c/uoto-osamu) and [Ohnishi Kouichi](https://mangadex.org/author/ec121b69-edeb-4624-955e-71aa1be927ee/ohnishi-kouichi) were once his assistants.

[Akimoto Osamu](https://mangadex.org/author/1cd79d33-68b3-4879-b67a-834055ef99eb/akimoto-osamu) is a fan of his.

His great uncle is the famous author, critic and poet [Itou Sei (伊藤整)](https://mangadex.org/author/c7df8af1-3b3d-4431-8adc-1e58ed8a7983/itoh-sei).

**Alt names**:
鶴田謙二

---
During his formative years in university as a student of optical science, Tsuruta, who had initially wanted to be a photographer, had been inspired by the works of numerous science fiction authors, such as Robert A. Heinlein, and manga artists, such as [Hoshino Yukinobu](https://mangadex.org/author/706826f2-20a1-413f-a874-706f1b1f64f0) and his manga [Saber Tiger](https://mangadex.org/title/af8a97fb-3098-4833-90b3-7fceffe231d1), which had inspired him to create manga. He has also cited [Chiba Tetsuya](https://mangadex.org/author/bb386677-86cf-43ee-bc3d-28f3bb4bdf4e) and his manga among his inspirations.

Soon after graduating, he wrote numerous doujinshi and was an assistant to numerous manga artists, prior to making his debut as a professional manga artist. In 1986, Tsuruta made his professional debut, authoring his first manga series, the short work, *Hirokute Suteki na Uchuu janai ka?* (広くてすてきな宇宙じゃないか?, a.k.a. What a Big Wonderful Universe It Is), which was serialized in Kodansha's Weekly Morning seinen magazine, set in a world where the land was sinking into water. Tsuruta has cited that the inspiration to this debut work of his came during a train journey from Tokyo to the ocean at Odawara, during which he had seen numerous rice paddies and thought of the possibility of a train line passing through the ocean, after which he wanted to create a work where he could use this image.

Soon after, Tsuruta authored [Spirit of Wonder](https://mangadex.org/title/39187992-cd1f-4095-9f25-cc532b938393), among his most famous works, in which he applied many of his inspirations, which was serialized in Kodansha's seinen magazines Weekly Morning and Afternoon between 1987 and 1996, and was later adapted into an anime series.

After Spirit of Wonder, Tsuruta wrote short manga works, and also illustrated numerous art books, which were quite successful. In 2002, he provided the character designs for the anime series Abenobashi Mahō Shōtengai and also authored its manga adaptation.

In 2000, 2001 and 2013, Tsuruta received the 31st, 32nd and 44th Seiun Awards for outstanding artist of the year. He has also received the Hayakawa Award for best illustrator, in 2000.

令嬢たちが愛されて幸せになるシンデレラストーリーを集めた「小説家になろう」発アンソロジーが登場! 不遇な令嬢が愛されて幸せになる、珠玉の読み切り5編を収録。美麗作画でお贈りする、溺愛系ピュアラブアンソロジーです♪ いずれも『小説家になろう』の大人気作です!

カバーイラスト：かわのあきこ

+++**第1巻の内容：**
1. 『奪われ続けた令嬢は虹乙女と呼ばれた』　漫画：宛　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6573fw/)：花散ここ
妖精に愛される「虹乙女」だったけれど、ある日婚約者も妖精も義妹に奪われてしまい……?
2. 『姉が駆け落ちしましたので。』　漫画：高岡れん　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n7291gp/)：月 
女好き男爵の後妻として身売りされそうになった令嬢の逆転ラブストーリー! 
3. 『貧乏令嬢はジャムを煮る ～妹の代わりに辺境伯に嫁ぐことになった平凡な貧乏子爵の令嬢ですが、このたび旦那様に溺愛されてスローライフを堪能することになりました～』　漫画：七十　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6131gp/)：咲倉未来
辺境の地に嫁いだ貧乏令嬢、辺境伯に愛されスローライフを満喫です!?
4. 『私あの時、不幸でよかったです。』　漫画：亜子　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5432gq/)：殿水結子
父親より年上の老騎士との政略結婚。悪夢の結婚生活と思いきや──?
5. 『奪われ令嬢は星にキスを捧げる』　漫画：黛けい　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0152er/)：長月おと 
美しい姉にすべてを奪われた伯爵令嬢は、家を飛び出して幸せを掴む――。
+++
+++**第2巻の内容：**
1. 『病んでるときも健やかなときも　～病んだ元王太子の婚約者になったので、全力で癒やして健やかにしてみた～』　漫画：あさここの　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2760gu/)：咲倉未来
我儘令嬢のとばっちりで婚約を交換!? 新しい婚約者は、心を病んだ元王太子様で…?
2. 『「所詮は政略結婚だ」と言い張るツンツン婚約者が、私を溺愛している件について』　漫画：深月アンネ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n7279hc/)：あろえ
円満な政略結婚を目指しても冷たくあしらわれ、嫌われていると確信していたけれど…?
3. 『恥を知れ 』　漫画：湯本みこ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6366hd/)：鈴宮
冷たい態度で恐れられる公爵と、氷の美貌の伯爵令嬢。似た者同士の二人の縁談は――。
4. 『怖がり娘と化け物伯爵 』　漫画：五味ちひろ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8885he/)：飛鳥
貧乏子爵令嬢の元に届いたのは、化け物と呼ばれる伯爵からの求婚の手紙!? 
5. 『婚約破棄を言い渡されましたが、恋した相手は貴方じゃなかったので大丈夫です。』　漫画：村井ナギサ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n1204ha/)：当麻リコ
手紙では優しかったはずの伯爵令息に、再会して即婚約破棄を言い渡され…!? 
+++
+++**第3巻の内容：**
1. 『そうして、孤独な歌姫は愛された』　漫画：かわのあきこ　原作：しきみ彰
虐げられた“口無し姫"の唯一のお役目。それは傷ついた幻獣を歌で癒すこと――。
2.  『このたび、別居婚となりました』　漫画：羽おり　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3161hb)：有沢真尋
政略結婚で隣国に嫁いだけれど、多忙な旦那様は一向に姿を見せなくて……?
3.  『おっとり娘と親切な殿下』　漫画：深月アンネ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9716cr/)：朝野りょう
王宮で開かれたパーティーで 貧乏令嬢が出会ったのは、面倒見の良すぎる王子様!?
4.  『婚約破棄をされました、変な人に拾われました。』　漫画：あまよかん　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5815gi)：木の実山ユクラ
婚約破棄直後の子爵令嬢は、絶対零度の貴公子から婚姻届を渡されて――?
5.  『第四王女の婚姻事情』　漫画：葉月　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n1062hj)：彩瀬あいり
男好きで色狂いだと噂されるお姫様――その正体は、城下町で働く庶民派王女!?
+++
+++**第4巻の内容：**
1. 『冬の小鳥と呼ばれた君へ』　漫画：戸山こま　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8359hh/)：三香
婚約者に虐げられながらも健気に尽くしていた「冬の小鳥令嬢」を待っていたのは…？
2. 『「何でもいい」と仰いますけど』　漫画：あまよかん　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2978hk/)：立草岩央
婚約破棄された令嬢の新たな嫁ぎ先は、氷のマリオネットと呼ばれる公爵様で――？
3. 『緑の手どころか、すべての植物を枯らしてしまう根絶やし令嬢です。結婚相手を探すために辺境に来ましたが、塩対応だったはずの義弟に溺愛されています。』　漫画：葉月　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3382hg/)：石河 翠
訳あり体質が原因でこのままだと行き遅れ!? こうなったら辺境の土地で婿探しします！
4. 『婚約破棄された悪役令息に「大丈夫？ おっぱい揉む？」と言ってしまった私の顛末』　漫画：くまのみ鮭　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9827ho/)：マチバリ
悪名を着せられ婚約破棄されてしまった初恋の相手を元気づけようとした伯爵令嬢は…？
5. 『没落令嬢は最強魔術師さまの介護をしています！』　漫画：オオトリ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5029hj/)：青戸部ラン
救国の英雄と呼ばれる最強魔術師の侍女兼介護人を務めることになり――？
+++
+++**第5巻の内容：**
1. 『婚約破棄された枯れ葉令嬢は超訳の名手』　漫画：深月アンネ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4608hs/)：三香
婚約者様は「ああ」としか返答がない寡黙な軍人!？円満な関係を築くため、ある能力に目覚め…？
2. 『土砂降り令嬢の傷心旅行』　漫画：羽おり　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0771go/)：狭倉 朏
婚約者に突き放され、悲しみに暮れた土砂降り令嬢は旅に出ることに――。
3. 『麗しの婚約者殿が笑顔を振りまくので、のぼせた令嬢から婚約破棄を要求されて大変です』　漫画：星田かな　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0104hs/)：雪菜
眉目秀麗で頭脳明晰な婚約者と甘え下手な令嬢。ある日、彼を想う令嬢から敵意を向けられて…。
4. 『薬学教室のキューピッド』　漫画：織部とき　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8675ht/)：bouro
卒業直前に婚約解消された嫌な思い出を払拭するため学園一のイケメンに告白します！
5. 『運良く成り上がった令嬢と繰り上げで英雄となった騎士』　漫画：伊七海五八　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6657hn/)：斯波
褒賞として13歳上の英雄に娶られるも「世継ぎを作るつもりはない」と宣言されてしまい…？
+++
+++**第6巻の内容：**
1. 『不運の令嬢と大強運の王子』　漫画：鳥居ナキ
強運の幼馴染を持つ不運すぎる公爵令嬢に、縁談の話が持ち上がり……？
2. 『そんなことも分からないの？』　漫画：ogita　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3971ib/)：鈴宮
王太子妃となった姉の汚点とならないよう、完璧な結婚を求められた落ちこぼれ令嬢は……？
3. 『冒険令嬢は人魚に夢を見る』　漫画：かわのあきこ
夢見るおてんば令嬢が望まぬ婚約パーティーの最中に出会ったのは――？
4. 『義妹の身代わりで隣国将軍の嫁にされた嫌われ令嬢です。夫が死ぬまで祖国に帰ってくるなと言われていたのに、優しい旦那さまを愛してしまいました。』　漫画：ぽんぬ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8402ib/)：石河 翠
あなたへの愛に気づいたのは、冷遇されると思っていた嫁ぎ先での穏やかな生活が壊れるとき――。
5. 『サーラ・メルディは歌えない』　漫画：はいいろ　原作：水野沙彰
両親に疎まれて声も奪われ幽閉されていた伯爵令嬢は、王宮付き魔法使いに救われ――？
+++
+++**第7巻の内容：**
1.  『嘲笑された貧乏令嬢の私に、みんなの憧れのパーフェクト王子様が興味を持ったようです』　漫画：すめうむ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3893iv/)：茅野ガク
父の治療費のために倹約する貧乏令嬢は、憧れの王子と出会い――？

食べ物に釣られて向かった縁談で、旦那様に一目惚れし――!?

美しい姉と比べられ虐げられてきた私。そんな私にも理解してくれる幼なじみがいて…。
4.  『初めまして旦那様。約束通り離縁してください ～溺愛してくる儚げイケメン将軍の妻なんて無理です～』　漫画：九十九万里　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3326ii/)：あさぎかな
円満離婚を計画し逃亡するも、旦那様に見つかり、溺愛され…？
5.  『欲しがりな妹の素敵な返戻品』　漫画：夜子　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0539gw/)：鈴宮
全てを妹に奪われてきた姉は、ある一つのものを取り返して――…。
6.  『推しの花嫁はお断りします！貧乏男爵令嬢は婚約者の騎士様に嫌われたい』　漫画：森野リエタ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n1804id/)：柊一葉
突然決まった推しとの婚約!?　畏れ多いので婚約解消を目指します！
+++
+++**第8巻の内容：**
1. 『刺繍で魔法陣を描いたら、天才魔法使いに求婚された』　漫画：鳥井まあ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3984iu/)：たちばな立花
冤罪で塔に幽閉された公爵令嬢の元に魔法使いが現れて…？
2. 『妹扱いする初恋の次期公爵に「あなたより素敵な人はいない」と伝えた結果』　漫画：中沢はと　原作：西根羽南
脈なしだと思っていた幼馴染の態度が一変し――!?
3. 『どうせ死ぬ命なので、誘拐犯に連れ去られてみます。』　漫画：蓑原みつき　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4052ka/)：にゃみ３
婚約者に裏切られ傷ついた「病弱姫」を救ったのは、一人の青年――。
4. 『住み込み先は幽霊公爵家！？ 〜義妹に奪われ追い出されましたが、溺愛の予感とハッピーエンドが待っていました〜』　漫画：本田清子　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8694jo/)：茅野ガク
義妹の嫌がらせで呪われていると有名な公爵家に就職決定!?
5. 『恋花令嬢は、まだ恋を知らない』　漫画：遊佐　原作：霜月零

Under the guise of an official reclamation program, the crown institutes a forced relocation policy to purge society's unwanted and appointing Laurentia as commander of a newly formed unit: The Silver Order.

Sent on a near-fatal assignment to reclaim the monster infested ruins of the Demon King's Castle, they refuse to perish. biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 真島ヒロ

**Birthdate:** May 3, 1977

Mashima Hiro first gained success with *Rave Master*, serialized in Koudansha's *Weekly Shounen Magazine* from 1999 to 2005. His best-selling work, *Fairy Tail*, published in the same magazine from 2006 to 2017, became one of the best-selling manga series ever with over 72 million copies in print. Mashima began the currently ongoing *EDENS ZERO* in 2018.

Mashima is known for many things, but his big three tend to be an artstyle reminiscent of *One Piece*, a love for the power of friendship, and a strong work ethic - at one point, he wrote six chapters of *Fairy Tail* in two weeks, and even recently simultaneously balanced drawing *EDENS ZERO*, doing storyboards for *Fairy Tail* spinoffs, and playing video games in his spare time.

description.en: Sailing aboard her bosom friend's, Dret's, pirate ship, Ledalia had only known a pirate's life all her 14 years, until the day they arrived upon the shores of Valencia. Tragedy strikes when Ledalia's trusted guardian Vector is killed by refugee hunters. With his dying breath, he reveals to Ledalia that she is actually a true-blooded princess of a country known as Mesaleena, which was laid ruin by Valencia's Illilian army, and that she had a twin brother that was locked away in a hidden tower! Angered and fueled by her lust for adventure, Ledalia begins her quest to save her brother and reclaim her birth right!

description.en:
Fushimi and Toume were just a normal boy and girl going to high school until one day they stumble upon a phantasmal mountain known to legend as "Mount Hagure" . Before either of them knew it, Toume was possessed by a Yoko named Dakini, a goddess who grants wishes.  
  
When asking what Fushimi's wish is, it is only this: Give Toume back. Dakini says she can grant the wish but in return he must become her servant. The deal is struck. Fushimi has now become Dakini's servant and Toume has been returned. Darkness, however, is afoot and now Fushimi must take on a more active role as Dakini's servant. Is he up for the task?!

description.en:
Shou Miyamoto and Yugo Itsukushima suddenly find themselves transported into the world of the RPG The Return of Gyasparc, complete with levels, classes, monsters, and magic. Armed with absurdly high stats and knowledge of the game, the two set out to find a way back home, but what begins as an adventure through a familiar game world soon draws them into the lives and troubles of the people who actually live there.

Along the way, they meet the sisters Ishura and Levia, take on monsters and quests, and discover that the world of Eternal may not be quite as simple as the game they remember.

description.en:
Mei, the daughter of a family that exterminates vicious monsters, was raised in a cold environment, lacking the power to exorcise demons. Meanwhile, her arrogant younger brother violates a taboo and awakens Ryouga, the king of another world! Mei is left behind... Mei is in danger, but Ryouga is actually a gentle, intelligent, and handsome young man. He teaches her the value of the rare "healing power" she possesses, and invites her to "become my princess."

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)
